note: Golden corpus for the client/server parity check. scan-parity.test.ts runs every entry through scanText() with the 065 seed rules; supabase/tests/111_moderation_client_rules_test.sql runs the identical strings through scan_content(). Both assert the count, so adding a case to one half and not the other fails. `expected` is the RAW severity — the advisory de-obfuscation pass has no server counterpart and is excluded by design. Several entries below are known false positives of the 065 seed, kept deliberately: they are what the category policy in policy.ts exists to soften.
